message.content:
This black-and-white editorial illustration shows a dense crowd of people with their arms raised. In the center, a muscular arm extends upward, the hand wearing a dark, fingerless glove clenched into a fist. This central fist has a dark watch or wristband with a metallic buckle. Numerous other hands and fists are raised throughout the scene, some blurred in the foreground and others receding into the background. The people visible are mostly young men with dark hair; their facial expressions range from focused to shouting. Some individuals hold smartphones.

The upper portion of the image features the word "TEMPO" in large, bold red letters. Above this, white text reads "EDISI KHUSUS TOKOH 2019". Below the "TEMPO" logo, smaller red text is partially visible but unclear. Across the middle of the image, the words "MASSA AKSI" appear in large, bold white capital letters with a dark outline. At the bottom left, there is a barcode with numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00045". Next to it, small white text includes "30 DESEMBER 2019-5 JANUARI 2020" and "RP 45.000". Other lines of text at the bottom are blurred and illegible.
